dedupe_keys.name: on the damping deterioration of power systems with cig based power plants performing pfr under communication delays

description: The documented simulation studies converter-interfaced PV primary frequency response with plant communication delay. It examines how delay, system inertia and line length affect 0.1–1.5 Hz oscillation damping and angle stability. This is a system-stability model, distinct from the field-identified plant model described in a companion study. Any shared plant parameters are unverified. Source grid-code statements are historical study context, not current legal guidance. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
